topics.title: Write about a dangerous experience you had, heard about, or watched in a film.
guiding_questions: Where and when did it happen?
How did you feel during it?
What did you learn from it?
topics.sample_essay: Last year, I saw a big fire in a shop near our house. It was at night. My father called the firemen fast. They came and put out the fire. I felt very afraid. My heart was beating fast. No one was hurt. I learned that we must be careful with fire. Safety is important.

topics.title: Write about ways to protect animals on the edge of extinction.
guiding_questions: What causes animals to be in danger?
What can we do to help them?
Why is it important to protect them?
What will happen if we do not help?
topics.sample_essay: Many animals are in danger today. People cut trees and hunt animals. We must protect these animals. We can make safe parks for them. We must stop hunting and keep water clean. Governments should make strong laws. Schools should teach children to love animals. Animals are part of our world. We must save them now.
